title: Aging may result from degraded bioelectric pattern memories that maintain tissue order

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Aging may result from degraded bioelectric pattern memories that maintain tissue order

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Levin proposes that aging is due to the degradation of endogenous bioelectric pattern memories required throughout life to maintain tissue order, so that solutions to aging need to target this information scaffold as well as cell-level rejuvenation (e.g. Yamanaka factors).

fields.label: Work
fields.value: The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2025, The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine › Applications and a Roadmap Toward a Radical Regenerative Medicine › A Better Understanding of Disease: From Molecular Markers to Physiological Patterns

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: we have previously proposed that aging is due to the degradation of important endogenous (bioelectric) pattern memories that are required throughout the lifespan to maintain tissue order [146, 147].

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine”, BioEssays : news and reviews in molecular, cellular and developmental biology (2025), doi:10.1002/bies.202400196; section “Applications and a Roadmap Toward a Radical Regenerative Medicine › A Better Understanding of Disease: From Molecular Markers to Physiological Patterns”. Scope: Aging tissues in multicellular animals

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2025-wisdom-21: needs-new-data, resolvability 0.43

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The hypothesis can be tested with spatial bioelectric imaging and causal restoration, but existing public ageing datasets provide only indirect molecular proxies. They lack the pattern-level longitudinal and intervention data needed to distinguish this mechanism from cell-autonomous ageing.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Longitudinally quantify tissue-scale voltage-pattern stability with age, then experimentally restore youthful patterns without cell reprogramming and test whether tissue organization and function improve beyond matched controls. Pattern decay preceding dysfunction and selective rescue would support the mechanism.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Available ageing atlases do not directly measure spatial voltage memories.

Correlation with ion-channel expression cannot establish pattern-memory degradation.

The decisive restoration intervention requires new longitudinal data.

fields.value:

data existence: 0.5

operationalizability: 0.6
analysis feasibility: 0.4

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The aging hypothesis can be turned into a longitudinal contrast between voltage-pattern stability and cell-intrinsic aging markers, with a restoration test. Public aging resources contain molecular and clinical clocks and do not contain the endogenous bioelectric patterns the claim treats as the information scaffold. The necessary paired measurements are not available for analysis.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Track tissue-scale resting-potential patterns in the same animals as they age, alongside cell-intrinsic aging markers, and test whether restoring the voltage pattern preserves tissue order when cell-level rejuvenation is held constant. Pattern decay predicting disorder, and pattern restoration preventing it, would support the claim; aging with an intact voltage pattern, or rescue by cell-level factors alone, would refute it.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Aging clocks and expression atlases do not record membrane-voltage pattern memory.

Pattern memory has to be specified so that ordinary loss of cell function is not counted as evidence.

No public longitudinal dataset pairs bioelectric prepatterns with tissue order across age.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.15
operationalizability: 0.5
data existence: 0.15
analysis feasibility: 0.2
discriminating power: 0.3
